# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 9, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on Aug 9, 2026, focused on stabilizing the agent framework across Web2/Web3 ecosystems. Key achievements include migrating connector settings to a modular UI, re-enabling Gmail sending, and resolving critical runtime planner and orchestrator bugs. CI stability was significantly improved through workflow consolidation and test-lane repairs.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### UI & Connector Migration
- Migrated Settings to a modular connector-based architecture with per-connector detail pages ([#18175](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18175)).
- Fixed app-host pairing issues by enabling in-process token redemption ([#18178](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18178)).
- Improved browser workspace UX by clearing page controls from the chat composer ([#18124](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18124)).

### Core Runtime & Agent Orchestration
- Fixed planner loop failures to ensure preserved tool results are delivered even if the loop dies mid-turn ([#18180](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18180)).
- Extended addressing gates to suppress meta-narration and improve engagement routing ([#18174](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18174), [#18177](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18177)).
- Improved orchestrator task management by reaping stuck tasks and preventing internal redirect instructions from leaking into chat ([#18118](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18118), [#18164](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18164)).

### Google Workspace & CI Stability
- Re-enabled Gmail sending and implemented security fail-safes against header injection ([#18112](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18112), [#18121](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18121)).
- Stabilized CI test lanes by serializing dependencies and bounding worker teardowns ([#18193](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18193), [#18136](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18136)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### CI & Workflow Cleanup
- Retired orphaned workflows and consolidated CI residue ([#16272](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16272), [#17233](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17233), [#17237](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17237)).
- Fixed CI gate timeouts and dependency declarations ([#17121](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17121), [#17224](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17224), [#17228](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17228), [#17949](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17949), [#17967](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17967), [#17976](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17976)).

### Cloud & Agent Stability

- Fixed issues with agent trajectory accounting and benchmark task cleanup ([#17532](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17532), [#17527](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17527)).

## NEW ISSUES

### CI & Infrastructure

### Core & Agent Logic
- Challenges with timezone handling in triggers, character gate notices, and sub-agent relay failures ([#18099](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18099), [#18098](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18098), [#18173](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18173), [#18176](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18176), [#18208](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18208)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES
- **[#16961](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16961) (Cloud Warm Pool):** Ongoing audit of image-drift and daemon-owned rollout phases. Latest analysis confirms the need for digest-aware rollout status and daemon-owned capacity guards.
- **[#18049](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18049) (Auth Latency):** Investigation into multi-second provider lookup spikes. Recent staging evidence shows the provider endpoint is warming, but bootstrap latency remains a concern for onboarding.
